motion.name: press-feedback
motion.purpose: Android press and ripple response for direct actions.

motion.name: selection
motion.purpose: Chips, toggles, and checked selection state.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet entry and dismissal with separate backdrop fade.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Preserve final state without nonessential motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action available in a task state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:52px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #FF4D7D; border-radius:16px; background:#FF4D7D; color:#FFFFFF; font:600 16px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:active { background:#E6386F; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #FFD6E1; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A safe alternate action without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:52px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #F2D7E3; border-radius:16px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#E6386F; font:600 16px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover,.ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#FFF0F4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #FFD6E1; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive or safety-sensitive action that remains visually explicit.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:52px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #D93A4F; border-radius:16px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#D93A4F; font:600 16px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-danger:hover,.ds-btn-danger:active { background:#FDEBED; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #F6B5BE; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A low-emphasis text action for navigation or optional work.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:14px; background:transparent; color:#E6386F; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover,.ds-btn-quiet:active { background:#FFF0F4; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #FFD6E1; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled 52 dp field with a visible error contract.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#3B1024; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-field input { min-height:52px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #F2D7E3; border-radius:14px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#3B1024; font:400 16px/24px system-ui; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:#FF4D7D; outline:2px solid #FFD6E1; } .ds-field small { color:#D93A4F; font:400 13px/18px system-ui; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A named 48 dp action for familiar Material symbols; never a text stand-in for an icon.
components.html: <button aria-label="Lưu hồ sơ" class="ds-icon-btn"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14l8-4 8 4V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H6z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width:48px; height:48px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#816776; transition:transform .12s,background .12s; } .ds-icon-btn svg { width:22px; height:22px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; } .ds-icon-btn:hover,.ds-icon-btn:active { background:#FFF0F4; transform:scale(.98); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #FFD6E1; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: State Panel
components.description: Truthful empty, error, or development context with one next action.
components.html:
Chưa có kết nối

Chỉ mutual like do máy chủ xác nhận mới mở trò chuyện.
components.css: .ds-state { padding:24px; border:1px solid #F2D7E3; border-radius:22px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#3B1024; font-family:system-ui; } .ds-state h3 { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:22px; line-height:29px; } .ds-state p { margin:0; color:#816776; font-size:16px; line-height:24px; } .ds-state:focus-within { border-color:#FF4D7D; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab-active">Khám phá</button><button>Đã lưu</button><button>Kết nối</button><button>Hồ sơ</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { min-height:66px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); border-top:1px solid #F2D7E3; background:#FFFFFF; } .ds-tabs button { border:0; background:transparent; color:#816776; font:400 13px/18px system-ui; } .ds-tabs button:hover,.ds-tabs button:focus-visible { background:#FFF0F4; outline:none; } .ds-tabs .ds-tab-active { color:#E6386F; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Sync Line
components.description: A real loading, selection, or readiness indicator; never fabricated progress.
components.css: .ds-sync div { height:4px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:999px; background:#FFF0F4; } .ds-sync span { display:block; width:55%; height:100%; background:#FF4D7D; } .ds-sync small { display:block; margin-top:8px; color:#816776; font:400 13px/18px system-ui; }

narrative.overview:
HeartSync uses a pale rose canvas, deep plum text, white task surfaces, and one decisive pink action. Portraits are the dominant content only when supplied by the service; empty states use an honest illustration rather than fabricated people, confirmation or activity.

Android navigation, system Back, touch targets, keyboard insets and screen-reader labels remain platform-safe. Device, large-text and dark-scheme review remain pending Android evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Pale rose canvas, deep plum type and a single Heart Pink action.
Portrait-led discovery and profile surfaces when real photo data exists.
White outlined inputs and rounded controls without decorative card stacks.
Native stack and four-destination bottom navigation with a pink active container.
Motion reinforces a completed choice or a changed state; it never delays a task.

rules.name: The Heart Pink Rule
rules.body: Heart Pink is reserved for a real primary action, selection or confirmed mutual connection; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Error states combine danger color with explanatory text, never color alone.

rules.name: The Confirmed Feedback Rule
rules.body: Success green and warning amber only explain a completed or recoverable state; Heart Pink remains the primary action and selection signal.

rules.name: The Direct Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use a direct title and supporting body copy; do not manufacture hierarchy with repeated uppercase kickers.

rules.name: The Native Orientation Rule
rules.body: Navigation and Back behavior remain platform-native; branded surfaces must not replace orientation controls.

rules.name: The Portrait-First Rule
rules.body: A supplied photo may own a discovery card, profile hero or call background; no illustration or mock photo may impersonate a user record.

dos: Do keep actions and explanations together within thumb reach.
Do preserve 48 dp minimum touch targets and native Back behavior.
Do use explicit empty, unavailable, error, and development copy.
Do prefer borders and tonal layering before introducing shadows.
Do provide a label for every icon-only action and respect system Reduce Motion.
Do pair an optimistic action with a visible recovery path when the server can reject it.
donts: Don't claim authentication, profiles, matches, realtime activity, or calls before server confirmation.
Don't repeat uppercase kickers or use-case identifiers as the primary production hierarchy; the Q01 placeholder labels are temporary traceability aids.
Don't use Heart Pink as ambient decoration or display fabricated progress, unread activity, distance, matches or call state.
Don't treat device behavior as approved until Android smoke and accessibility tests are recorded.
Don't replace Material affordances with text labels such as “Mở”, “Bỏ”, “Tăng”, or “Giảm” when a familiar icon is clearer.
